review_candidates.title: Enterprise Architect - Data
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The role is responsible for establishing a scalable and sustainable data foundation that supports operational excellence, reporting, compliance, business performance management, and future digital transformation initiatives. YOUR NEW KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE STRATEGY & OWNERSHIP : Own and evolve the Enterprise Data Architecture vision and strategy. Define and maintain target-state architectures, reference models, and transformation roadmaps for enterprise data capabilities.
eligibility_evidence: We bring together more than 30,000 people from over 70 nationalities, coming from five continents.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure data management practices support regulatory, privacy, security, and compliance requirements BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION & VALUE ENABLEMENT: Data Platform & Integration Architecture Define architectural standards for enterprise data platforms and data integration capabilities. Best-of-Breed Technology Expertise: Specific experience with modern enterprise data platforms and technologies is highly desirable, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Purview, Power BI, SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), SAP BW / BW4HANA, SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
